description: Codex, design review of the Python versions (round 1): a t-string (PEP 750, Python 3.14) is not a docstring — Python reads it as a TemplateStr, not a str constant, and evaluates its interpolations. `t"{1 / 0}"` raises before `self.skipTest("pending")`, so the skip is not the first statement of the test (F2): a WARN, never a FAIL. The real runner reports an error, no skip.
